summary: Master personal branding for sales professionals. Build authority, optimize your SSI, and accelerate your pipeline with our 5-day expert-led training program.
lede: Personal Branding for Sales Professionals gives you a structured way to align your professional identity with the value you deliver. Over five days, you will develop practical skills in content curation, LinkedIn optimization, network mapping, video sales letters, and digital reputation management. You will learn to turn scattered online activity into a measurable part of your sales process using the Social Selling Index, Personal Value Proposition framework, and CRM workflows. The course also covers content planning, AI-supported outreach, sentiment analysis, and efficient brand maintenance so you can build authority while protecting time for prospecting and closing deals.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for experienced sales practitioners and leaders who operate in high-stakes, relationship-driven environments where digital credibility is a prerequisite for engagement.
modules: Optimizing Digital Real Estate for Conversion
Multimedia Sales Presence and Video Strategy
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3 years in a professional sales role and an active LinkedIn profile. Access to LinkedIn Sales Navigator and a laptop for hands-on exercises are required.
